evaluation_scope: Per-pack Zitadel deployment + identity-related K8s resources

5.1.1_minimum_rbac.evidence: ServiceAccount per ADR-0148 SPIFFE binding; no cluster-admin

5.1.2_minimize_secret_access.evidence: CONTRADICTED 2026-07-26: iac/helm/zitadel/templates/deployment.yaml:52-60 sources the Postgres host/port/database/username/password via secretKeyRef from K8s Secret zitadel-postgres-user, so credentials do transit K8s Secret objects

5.2.1_minimize_privileged_container.evidence: Zitadel pod runs as non-root per ADR-0146 distroless-nonroot

5.2.8_apparmor_profile.evidence: CONTRADICTED 2026-07-26: no AppArmor annotation or appArmorProfile field anywhere under oya/identity/iac/helm/; the chart sets seccomp only

5.4.1_image_signed.evidence: CONTRADICTED 2026-07-26: the buildkit signing step cannot execute — jq and curl are both absent from moby/buildkit, so DIGEST=$(jq -r ...) exits 127 under set -euo pipefail before cosign is downloaded (F-SEC-IMAGE-SIGNING-NEVER-RAN)

5.4.2_image_pinned_by_digest.evidence: CONTRADICTED 2026-07-26: exactly ONE container image reference in the repository is digest-pinned; ~87 values.yaml ship an empty digest: "" (F-SUPPLY-IMAGE-PINS-UNDIGESTED)

5.4.3_image_distroless_or_minimal_base.evidence: Zitadel distroless image; oyatie µservices per ADR-0146

5.7.3_pod_security_standards_enforced.evidence: CONTRADICTED 2026-07-26: the sole Kyverno ClusterPolicy scopes all rules to namespaces: ["cloud-k8s-system"], while identity deploys to identity-{{ .Values.packLabel }}, so the policy never matches this workload
